main:14.text: Yuna and I secured a staging camp at Jogaku Temple, but the paths into Toyotama are blocked - and we’ll need reinforcements if we’re going to take the fight to the Khan. I should speak with Yuna at Jogaku Temple to plan our next attack. ― Jin, before starting the Tale The roads into Toyotama are blocked, but I’m going to break through. Yuna’s hunter contacts agreed to help us retake Fort Kaminodake from the Mongols.

main:16.text: The storm is coming. It’s time we make our final preparations to strike Khotun Khan. I don’t know if we’ll survive, and I don’t know if Lord Shimura will reinforce us. But I can’t turn back now. Yuna should be with the others at Jogaku Temple. I should speak with her before we end this. ― Jin The storm is here. With the winds at our back, we are launching our attack against the Mongol stronghold at Port Izumi.

main:17.text: The Khan is defeated, but I have one last personal matter to deal with…. Lord Shimura has asked me to meet him under the red-leafed tree by Omi Lake. I need to face him. I won’t keep running. ― Jin I have met Lord Shimura by Omi Lake, as he requested. We have much to talk about. Whatever the future brings, I will see this through. I owe him that much. ― Jin

side:2.text: Sensei Ishikawa's traitorous former student, Tomoe, is training Mongol archers in Hiyoshi. We stopped some from brutalizing a small settlement, but Tomoe is still out there. I will meet Ishikawa at his dojo to plan our next move. ― Jin Sensei Ishikawa's traitorous former student, Tomoe, is training Mongol archers in Hiyoshi. Her archers have surrounded Hiyoshi Springs, cutting it off ahead of a Mongol attack.

side:3.text: Sensei Ishikawa and I learned that his traitorous former student, Tomoe, is leading an attack on Hiyoshi Springs. We need to save the town from annihilation. ― Jin Sensei Ishikawa's traitorous former student, Tomoe, seems to be training Mongol archers for an attack on Hiyoshi Springs. The sensei is filled with remorse for teaching her, but his guild will save no one. Our only recourse is action.

side:12.text: Lady Masako has gone to Umugi to look for other conspirators who killed her family. Umugi Cove is home to smugglers, ronin and thieves - the perfect hiding place for a traitor. ― Jin

side:14.text: One of the conspirators in the Adachi massacre is hiding in Kushi. The territory is heavily occupied by Mongols. I need to meet up with Masako, so we can hunt down the traitor before the Mongols reach them. ― Jin

side:15.text: Lady Masako’s list of conspirators grows thin, but the person who organized the attack on Clan Adachi is yet to be found. Masako has gone to Otsuna - perhaps she has new information? ― Jin

side:16.text: Lady Masako has tracked her sister to Clan Kikuchi’s old fort. We will make our way there and confront her. Masako appears determined to do what she must. But her sister is the only family she has left… a sacrifice that will bring honor, but with it a great burden. ― Jin

side:18.text: The farm here looks like it's had some trouble. I should make sure the people there are all right. ― Jin I was surprised to find Kenji on a farm in Tsutsu. He claimed to be helping the farmers keep their food out of Mongol hands. I suggested an ambush. He said it wouldn't be that easy. Nothing with Kenji ever is... ― Jin

side:27.text: Mongols are about to attack Kushi Temple. I need to protect the monks outside the temple grounds, while Norio insists he must defend the temple. ― Jin The Mongols tried to punish Kushi Temple for resisting the invasion. Norio and l defended the temple, but another attack is coming. Norio and I will ensure Kushi Temple remains safe. ― Jin

side:54.text: There's a shrine near here with smoke coming from its location. I hope it's all right. The Mongols have now set their focus on our shrines and the foxes who call them home. I'll find every Mongol whose blade was drawn against these sacred messengers. They will soon understand what it's like to be hunted.
